annotations.title: Get an FDA recall by number

description: Get one U.S. FDA device recall by its recall number: status (ongoing, completed or terminated), FDA recall class, start date, reason, product description, product code, recalling firm, the 510(k), PMA or De Novo numbers it names and the name-matched DevicErts manufacturer page. Use when a recall number is known, such as Z-0079-2022. Do not use to find recalls by product, firm, class or date (use search_recalls) or for the recalls of one device (use get_device_recalls). EU field safety notices (FSCA) are not in the catalogue. Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

recall_number.description: The FDA recall number, 3 to 40 characters; letter case and spaces are ignored. e.g. Z-0079-2022, Z-1234-2020
